response.reconstructed_markdown:
Under the new tax regime in India, there is zero income tax on taxable income up to ₹12 lakh for eligible individuals through the Section 87A rebate, which extends up to ₹12.75 lakh for salaried individuals when factoring in the ₹75,000 standard deduction. [0]

- For General/Other Taxpayers: Taxable income up to ₹12,00,000 has a zero tax liability due to the rebate under Section 87A.
- For Salaried Taxpayers: The limit extends up to ₹12,75,000 because of the combined benefit of the standard deduction \(₹75,000\) and the Section 87A tax rebate. [0] [1]

If you'd like, I can help you calculate your precise tax liability based on your exact salary breakdown and other sources of income.
